# BoredMutant

> BoredMutant builds automated client document collection systems for CPA firms, accounting firms and staffing agencies in the United States. Unlike client-portal tools, it needs no portal and no new software: everything happens in ordinary email. The system is installed inside the firm's own mailbox: it tracks which client owes which document, sends escalating firm-approved reminder emails on a set schedule, stops automatically the moment the document arrives, and hands the thread to staff if the client replies with a question. Setup takes about a week. Every build starts with a two-day dry run. Month to month, cancel anytime.

Canonical URL: https://www.boredmutant.com/
Contact: contact@boredmutant.com
Booking: https://cal.com/boredmutant/automations (15-minute intro call)

## What the product does

1. **Load the list.** The firm sends its existing tracker or a plain CSV: client, document, deadline.
2. **Approve three templates:** polite, firmer, final. Written in the firm's own voice and approved once. The system generates no text of its own; it only decides *when* to send and when to stop.
3. **Send from the firm's mailbox.** Reminders go out under the firm's name, address and signature, via Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. Clients never see BoredMutant's name.
4. **React to the reply.** If the document arrives, that client's chase shuts off automatically. If the client replies with a question, the chase pauses and the thread is routed to a human, flagged.
5. **Friday digest.** One weekly email: what arrived, what is outstanding, who gets chased next.

Default escalation schedule: day 1 polite reminder, day 4 firmer follow-up, day 8 final notice, then stop on receipt. Adjustable per client and per document type.

## Who it is for

- **Accounting firms:** chasing 1099s, K-1s, bank statements, signed 8879s and prior-year returns, especially around extension deadlines.
- **Staffing agencies:** chasing I-9s, certifications, references, compliance documents and timesheets before start dates.

## Data handling

- Attachments never leave the firm's inbox. BoredMutant never opens, stores or moves the files themselves.
- The system tracks names, email addresses and document titles only.
- All email sends through the firm's own mailbox using the firm's own credentials.
- Every new firm runs two days in dry-run mode, watching every email the system *would* have sent, before any real message goes out.

## Pricing

- **Founding client:** $990 one-time setup, then $250/month. Limited to three slots per industry. Includes the full chaser, three escalation templates, the two-day dry run, the weekly digest, and unlimited clients and document types.
- **Standard:** $1,500+ one-time setup, then $300–$400/month. Adds priority support and a quarterly tune-up of escalation timing.
- Month to month. No annual contract.

## Who runs it

BoredMutant is an independent automation studio founded in 2025 and run by a single engineer, who is also the person on every call. It is deliberately small: clients talk to the person who built their system.

- [Document chasing for staffing agencies](https://www.boredmutant.com/document-chasing-for-staffing-agencies): I-9s, certifications, licenses, references, background check consent and weekly timesheets, mapped to the placement pipeline.
